registration_timing: Registered after the original fresh-100 H6 result was classified inconclusive at 99 pairs and after the resilient-pair promotion gate passed, but before generation or fitting of replicates 121 through 220.
purpose: Independently replicate the normal-Person JMLE threshold-RMSE effect of planned-connected versus complete observation design without replacing the missing original confirmatory row.

data_generating_process.paired_randomness: Within replicate, planned-connected rows are a deterministic subset of the complete response matrix.

primary.metric: within-run RMSE of TruthError over all six registered PCM threshold elements
primary.test: one-sample Student t test of 100 paired replicate contrasts against zero
primary.multiplicity: single registered primary hypothesis; no adjustment required
primary.decision_rule: Replicated only if all 100 Python pairs are finite, the mean contrast is positive, and the one-sided p value is at most 0.05. Precision qualification is reported separately.
primary.missing_rule: No imputation, replacement, or diagnostic replay. Fewer than 100 finite Python pairs is inconclusive.

facets_calibration_secondary_gate.retry_policy: facets_resilient_pair_plan_20260811.json: maximum two retries only for exit-0/missing-report
facets_calibration_secondary_gate.display_precision: FACETS U6 main/threshold pass and separate U2 Table 8 pass; no raw fit reconstructed from displayed two-decimal values.

secondary_descriptive_outputs: FACETS retry counts and failure denominators
prohibitions: Do not pool replicates 1 through 120 into the primary replication test.
Do not use a FACETS diagnostic replay to replace a missing Python pair.
Do not change the original confirmatory H6 status or strict batch qualification.
Do not rank JMLE, MML, and CMLE or compare likelihoods across bases.
Do not promote secondary threshold elements after result inspection.
claim_limit: A successful result independently replicates one observation-design sensitivity effect in this registered normal-Person heterogeneous-PCM DGM. It does not establish universal missing-data bias or FACETS-wide compatibility.
